summary: 53-year-old Alabama man severely ill at a park wilderness campsite ~5 miles from the North Inlet Trailhead on the west side of Rocky Mountain National Park; RMNP SAR team plus two Grand Lake Fire Protection District members hiked in and provided advanced medical care; assisted walking to the trailhead by 4 a.m. Thursday, July 11; ambulance to Middle Park Medical Center
location: Wilderness campsite ~5 mi from North Inlet Trailhead, Rocky Mountain National Park (west side)
responding_agency: RMNP SAR (Grand Lake Fire Protection District assisted)
notes: Date from article text (Wednesday night, July 10, 2019); same opened article as the Longs Trough fall
